findings.what: The fix put the questionnaire projection inside the mapping to demo_unavailable, but the body of both demo routes is serialized after the handler returns, outside any mapping, so a body the projection could build and JSON.stringify cannot write still goes to onError as 500 server_error. Measured in process (the local app, the function app and the entry, the same code the Vercel function runs), with a depth scan of 461 depths × 5 places: an array nested 6 900 to 9 700 deep in a question title gives GET /api/demo/questionnaire 500 server_error while POST /api/demo/result answers 200; an array nested 6 900 to 9 725 deep in a solution's includes gives the result 500 (the same window before the fix); objects overflow the projection first and answer 503. On a freshly started real local server the projection overflows first (503 from 1 750 cold, from 3 500 after 4 000 warm requests) and no 500 was seen in 23 cold depths and 38 000 warm requests; the stack depth of the function on the platform is not measured. The precondition is the one of L2 of pass 1, an intake in the repository that the content step refuses (E_JSON «Слишком глубокая вложенность»); check-public also stops on such an intake (issue I3), so the open build refuses it. The app keeps answering and every other route is unchanged, so Q10 holds; the two routes name one broken intake with two codes again.
findings.fix: Serialize inside the mapping: the route loop (or each demo handler) turns the body into its text inside a try and maps a failure of a demo route to demo_unavailable; or widen loadIntake to the shapes the routes read (every title, label, name, summary, no_match_text a {ru, kk, en} object of strings; includes and not_suitable_when lists of such objects), so that such an intake is refused at the start and both routes answer 503 (this also closes L2). Not reachable from the CLI, which always writes in place (outDir = publicDir), so only a caller of runBuild that passes its own output folder (the tests) meets it; Low.
findings.fix: In the branch that copies, refuse an output folder that exists and is not empty, or run refuseLinks(d.outDir) when it exists, before fs.cpSync; a VB row: an existing output folder with a folder link → exit 1, the outside folder byte-equal; the mutant «refusal after the copy» red.
